propositions: fsck detects three classes of dirty-tree wedges (tracked deletions, untracked regenerable leftovers, orphaned .tmp-event-* files) and reports each in both text and JSON output via _STRUCTURED_KINDS registration

doctor --repair heals wedged stores using two non-overlapping write-lock windows: one for file mutations (restore deletions, quarantine leftovers) and a second where reconverge self-locks and converges
repair mutations are non-destructive (restore via git checkout HEAD, move to quarantine rather than delete) and guarded by a backup ref at tickets HEAD recorded before any mutation
class-3 .tmp-event-* files are left untouched and marked for manual triage; unclassified .retired files (not at HEAD or sync remote) are not classified to preserve single copies
doctor --repair is idempotent and refuses all mutations if backup ref cannot be created; failed checkout/quarantine operations are marked unrepairable and exit non-zero
lock discipline is enforced: write_lock is held during file mutations but released before reconverge entry, and repair holds no outer lock to avoid starving internal acquisitions
